notes.title: Play our demo now!
notes.content:
Hey cozy gamer friends and cleaning games enjoyers!  

We are so happy to announce that our demo is now playable on Steam! 🎉
Go check our store page to download the demo and let us know what you think about this little preview of Clean Up Earth.

In this demo you'll have access to :
- A few tutorial maps
- A few solo/co-op maps
- 1 multiplayer map in the "Oasis"
- Customizable character



Keep in mind that this is just a glimpse of Clean Up Earth and what we're working on.
The team would be happy to read your feedback about our game.

If you want to join us and help us build Clean Up Earth, don't forget to join our Discord : https://discord.gg/4VT5Y8KuxH

We can't wait to show you more about Clean Up Earth!
